verdict.rationale: Paddle documents its own reporting features: reports generated via API to feed accounting and BI systems, a subscriptions report covering every subscription, and metrics available from the dashboard or API. That is a real but narrow data-export capability, not a documented full-account export or exit path. Missing for 10: a documented export of all account data, named open file formats (e.g. CSV/JSON downloads), portability or migration-out of customer and payment data, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Generate reports via API to feed into accounting and BI systems
Generate a new subscriptions report to see the state and details of every subscription
Filter, break down, and investigate the metrics and data available in your Paddle account from the dashboard or the API.
